items.author: Murphychen888
items.name: Murphy
items.summary: 用 2023 年 1–9 月的經驗看短期持有者成本線（STH-RP）的標準差帶：碰到 +1 標準差遇阻後回調，回到成本線或 −1 標準差之間。現在成本線約 75,700、−1 標準差約 68,900，列出三種回撤情境，「不做預測，只做計劃」。
items.reply: 我用 Bitview 的成本算了同一組帶，數字跟你很接近：成本 75,961、−1 標準差 69,096。這輪 9/21 的高點剛好碰到 +1.26 個標準差就回頭，跟你說的 2023 年遇阻是同一個樣子；現在回到 +0.14，貼著均值。
items.sources: 短期持有者成本 75,961、−1 標準差 69,096、現在 +0.14 個標準差、120 日最高 +1.26（9/21）· 11/04 · Bitview（近 4 年價格÷成本的平均 ± 標準差）
items.note: Murphy 一律優先。他的帶是成本 ± 標準差，我們是成本 ×（價格÷成本的平均 ± 標準差），所以 +1 的位置不同（我們的 +1 是 88,997），回覆只對 −1 和成本，不碰他的 +1；他的三種情境（交易計劃）不評論。

image.title: 同一組成本帶：成本 75,961、−1 標準差 69,096

items.quote:
Murphy 用短期持有者成本的標準差帶回看 2023 年：碰到 +1 標準差遇阻，回到成本線附近。我用 Bitview 算同一組帶，成本 75,961、−1 標準差 69,096，和他的 75,700、68,900 幾乎一樣。這輪 9/21 高點到 +1.26 就回頭，現在 +0.14。

items.summary: Bitcoin ETF demand has changed regime: late October inflows faded within days, flows flipped to strong outflows, and in that regime BTC daily returns have usually been negative.
items.reply: Agree on the regime shift. One thing in the daily prints though: −$643M on Oct 30, −$399M on Nov 2, −$116M on Nov 3 (provisional). Still outflows, but each day smaller. Nov 4 hasn't printed yet, and that's the one I'm watching.

items.author: 1MarkMoss
items.name: Mark Moss
items.summary: Midterms came and went; looks at 70+ years / 19 midterms for what comes next for markets and Bitcoin. Midterm years are tough, October is usually the worst month.
items.reply: One midterm detail from on-chain I didn't expect: in 2022, the 6–12 month holder cost fell below the 12–18 month cost on Nov 8, election day itself. The golden cross took 367 days to come. This cycle that death cross already happened on July 15, 112 days ago.
items.note: 18 萬粉、發文約 2 小時，建議用引用；只講歷史，不推論後市。

image.title: 2022: death cross on election day. 2026: July 15

items.quote:
Mark Moss is looking at 19 midterms. One on-chain detail: in 2022 the 6–12m holder cost crossed below the 12–18m cost on election day (Nov 8), and the golden cross took 367 days. This cycle it came July 15, 112 days ago.

items.author: P23Sanjay
items.name: Sanjay
items.summary: 2022 midterms marked the cycle bottom ($18.5K on election day, then ~$15.5K). 2026 midterms: $77K, 39% off ATH, low already in at $58.5K months ago; bottom looks front-loaded this cycle.
items.reply: The $58.5K low lines up with something I track: long-term holder supply in loss peaked at 45.4% on June 30, right at $58.4K. 2019 topped at 46.4%, 2022 at 44.7%. It's back down to 31.5% now.
items.note: 原文結尾有「慢慢 DCA」的建議，回覆只講數據，不呼應。

items.summary: BTC back above 80K after the midterms; CoinGlass shows $363M liquidated in one hour, $269M of it shorts. "Nothing changed on chain last night, people just stopped being scared." Prefers spot and patience over leverage.
items.reply: Agree on the leverage part. Small pushback on "nothing changed on chain" though: STH-SOPR went from 0.9954 to 1.0021, and the share of short-term holder supply in profit jumped from 30.25% on Nov 2 to 62.89%. New buyers flipped from selling at a loss to selling at cost.
